description:
🚀 We are a team of enthusiastic students passionate about space exploration, science, technology, and innovation. Our project, Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer, aims to create an interactive platform to introduce young learners to astronaut training and space missions.

We welcome creative thinkers and passionate learners who enjoy teamwork and problem-solving.

Looking for: Web developers (HTML, CSS, JavaScript), UI/UX designers, space science enthusiasts, researchers, and presentation skills
